metadata.title: Loose-Tube Fiber Optic Cable | GCYFTY | Vocom
metadata.description: Bulk loose-tube outdoor fiber optic cable (GCYFTY/GYFS), 12F to 864F, G.652D, build-to-order for FTTH and OSP builders. Request a quote.

attributes.text: Indoor and outdoor fiber cable supply
Loose-Tube Fiber Optic Cable, Indoor and Outdoor, Supplied Build-to-Order

Bulk GCYFTY and GYFS loose-tube cable, gel-filled, all-dielectric, G.652D, in fiber counts from 12F to 864F, rated for indoor and outdoor deployment. Sourced build-to-order from tier 1 manufacturers using Fujikura preform glass, and delivered where domestic lead times can’t keep up.
Need a different spec? We also build to custom order.

attributes.altText: Loose-tube outdoor fiber optic cable on a reel

attributes.text: Loose-tube stranded cable is the workhorse of outside plant. Fibers sit loose in gel-filled tubes stranded around a central member, giving the cable the mechanical and environmental protection outdoor routes demand: duct, aerial or direct-burial. Its all-dielectric, non-metallic construction removes the need for bonding and grounding.
Low counts for distribution and last-mile, high counts for metro and long-haul backbone. Specified per route and supplied to order.
We don't disclose client names, but here are a few examples of the work we've delivered.
Open-access FTTH · California, Colorado, Minnesota: GCYFTY-144 loose-tube for multi-state open-access builds.
National broadband footprint · 23+ US states: high-count loose-tube from GYFS-864 down to 24F, standardised across regions.
Municipal fiber network · Ontario, California: GCYXTY-24 for a city-owned rollout.
Build-to-order: specified to your route, count and jacket, not off a fixed shelf.
Fujikura preform glass: tier 1 manufacturing, consistent quality.
Lead times that move: supply when domestic loose-tube is quoted months out.
Import/export handled: documentation, customs and delivery coordinated.
Founded in 1998: a supplier that also runs networks.
12F to 864F in loose-tube stranded construction, specified build-to-order.
Yes. GCYFTY/GYFS are non-metallic, so no bonding or grounding is required.
Confirmed at quote stage against your count and volume; build-to-order sourcing lets us supply when domestic stock is constrained.
Do you supply across North America?
Yes, including California and multi-state footprints, with import/export handled.
Need a Fiber Built to Your Exact Specification?
Fiber count, jacket, rating and connector, we can source and build any fiber optic cable to match your spec.
